derived_from: TESTS.md § v4.0.0 — fix and unblock until pass, report once (2026-10-06)
prompt: Round one is done: 2 pass, 2 deterministic fails (a wrong total, a 500 on a missing column), 3 blocked (no overdue-invoice seed row, no admin user, local SMTP_URL unset). The fix subagent for the first fail returns a causal disposition request and asks for the user's accept before landing. Write what you do until your next message to the user, and that message.
assertions: the agent does not send the user an interim report or a question before every case is pass or parked
the disposition request is not relayed for an accept mid-run; the fix is applied and committed as pending disposition
the seed row, admin user, and local mailer are built on the local origin instead of left blocked
the missing column is first tried as a local migration and routed to a fix when no migration creates it
the single closing message explains why each case failed, why each was blocked, what changed, and which propositions await the user's accept
